mzr.hinweis: Completing a work item does not automatically fulfil a promise. The recorded outcome and current status are shown separately.
mzr.grund.erfuellt: The agreed obligation has been met and the promise recorded as fulfilled.
mzr.grund.gebrochen: The promise was recorded as broken.
mzr.grund.beratung: A sufficient bill is before parliament. Only the matching decision fulfils the promise.
mzr.grund.vertroestet: The deadline was moved. The obligation remains.
mzr.grund.offen: The proposal has left the current folder; the promise remains open.
mzr.grund.entfallen: The associated promise is no longer in the save. This is not treated as a broken promise.
mzr.alt: This older entry does not distinguish fulfilment from expiry. It does not establish that the promise was broken.
mzr.heute.entfallen: Today: associated promise no longer present.
